lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the pectoral fin region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with primary circular nodes to form a structured grid across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges with sharp vertical luminance gradients, exhibiting light upper boundaries and shadowed lower margins.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 10-15 high-intensity spots within the visible silhouette of the dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small dark appendage attached near the posterior-distal edge of the pectoral fin; minor notch visible on the fin's trailing margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, irregular micro-spotting on the head and pectoral fin surfaces, distinct from the larger, ordered pattern on the main body.
